Subject: Claim Decision Regarding Your Theft Claim

Dear {CLAIMANT_NAME},

We have completed our review of your claim regarding the theft of your vehicle. At this time, we are unable to approve your request for coverage.

Our records indicate that your policy provides liability coverage only and does not cover damage to or theft of your own vehicle. This is based on the following policy clause: "[LIAB-2] This policy provides liability coverage only."

If you disagree with this decision, you may ask for a review by replying to this letter within 30 days with any additional information.

Please contact us if you have any questions regarding this decision.

ClaimPilot Claims Team
